source_snapshot.title: Resolve Dubai rental disputes quickly: Amicable solutions without court
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Landlords and tenants in Dubai are increasingly resolving rental disputes without lengthy court proceedings, with 2,350 cases worth Dh401 million settled amicably in an average of just six days during the first nine months of 2026.The figures, released by Dubai’s Rental Disputes Centre (RDC), highlight the growing importance of conciliation as a faster and less confrontational way to settle disagreements between property owners and tenants.Between January and September 2026, the centre successfully concluded 2,350 amicable settlement cases, helping disputing parties reach mutually acceptable solutions while protecting their legal rights.How the settlement process workUnder the RDC’s conciliation system, landlords and tenants involved in rental disagreements are given an opportunity to resolve their differences through a structured legal process.Rather than proceeding directly to formal litigation, both parties can negotiate a mutually acceptable agreement with the assistance of the centre’s Conciliation and Settlement Department.Once an agreement is reached, it is approved by a supervising judge, giving it the legal force of an enforceable instrument.This means the settlement is not merely an informal understanding but a legally enforceable agreement designed to protect the rights of both parties.Greater confidenceJudge Abdulqader Mousa Mohammed, Chairman of the Rental Disputes Centre, said the results demonstrated the effectiveness of Dubai’s approach to resolving rental disagreements.“The performance of the amicable settlement mechanism during the first nine months of this year underscores its capacity to bring rental disputes to swift and effective conclusions and confirms that timely resolution, procedural quality, and the protection of rights are all integral outcomes of efforts grounded in specialised expertise and an immediate response to the needs of disputing parties. The RDC continues to advance its legal framework to support the stability of contractual relationships and foster confidence in Dubai’s judicial system.”Why amicable settlements matterFor landlords and tenants, amicable settlements offer an opportunity to resolve disputes without the time and uncertainty often associated with formal court proceedings.The process allows both sides to negotiate practical solutions while preserving contractual relationships wherever possible.According to the RDC, the approach also helps reduce the social and economic consequences of prolonged rental disagreements.As Dubai’s rental market continues to grow, the centre said it remains focused on improving dispute resolution procedures, ensuring fair access to justice and encouraging landlords and tenants to settle disagreements through conciliation. .Dubai rental dispute process: How to file a case, fees, documents and what happens next.Ajman issues new decree setting fees and deposits for rental dispute cases.Dubai landlord refusing to return your security deposit? The total value of these disputes was 401 million dirhams.
The average time to resolve disputes was six days.
The reconciliation process is conducted through the Rental Disputes Centre.
Parties negotiate with the support of specialists at the centre.
The agreement is approved by a judge and becomes legally binding.

evidence_passages.text: Resolve Dubai rental disputes quickly: Amicable solutions without court

Dubai: Landlords and tenants in Dubai are increasingly resolving rental disputes without lengthy court proceedings, with 2,350 cases worth Dh401 million settled amicably in an average of just six days during the first nine months of 2026.The figures, released by Dubai’s Rental Disputes Centre (RDC), highlight the growing importance of conciliation as a faster and less confrontational way to settle disagreements between property owners and tenants.Between January and September 2026, the centre successfully concluded 2,350 amicable settlement cases, helping disputing parties reach mutually acceptable solutions while protecting their legal rights.How the settlement process workUnder the RDC’s conciliation system, landlords and tenants involved in rental disagreements are given an opportunity to resolve their differences through a structured legal process.Rather than proceeding directly to formal litigation, both parties can negotiate a mutually acceptable agreement with the assistance of the centre’s Conciliation and Settlement Department.Once an agreement is reached, it is approved by a supervising judge, giving it the legal force of an enforceable instrument.This means the settlement is not merely an informal understanding but a legally enforceable agreement designed to protect the rights of both parties.Greater confidenceJudge Abdulqader Mousa Mohammed, Chairman of the Rental Disputes Centre, said the results demonstrated the effectiveness of Dubai’s approach to resolving rental disagreements.“The performance of the amicable settlement mechanism during the first nine months of this year underscores its capacity to bring rental disputes to swift and effective conclusions and confirms that timely resolution, procedural quality, and the protection of rights are all integral outcomes of efforts grounded in specialised expertise and an immediate response to the needs of disputing parties.

The RDC continues to advance its legal framework to support the stability of contractual relationships and foster confidence in Dubai’s judicial system.”Why amicable settlements matterFor landlords and tenants, amicable settlements offer an opportunity to resolve disputes without the time and uncertainty often associated with formal court proceedings.The process allows both sides to negotiate practical solutions while preserving contractual relationships wherever possible.According to the RDC, the approach also helps reduce the social and economic consequences of prolonged rental disagreements.As Dubai’s rental market continues to grow, the centre said it remains focused on improving dispute resolution procedures, ensuring fair access to justice and encouraging landlords and tenants to settle disagreements through conciliation.

title: Resolve Dubai rental disputes quickly: Amicable solutions without court
summary_ru: 🏠 В Дубае арендные споры решают за шесть дней В первые девять месяцев 2026 года в Дубае было урегулировано 2 350 арендных споров на сумму 401 млн дирхамов без судебных разбирательств. Среднее время решения споров составило всего шесть дней. Процесс примирения проходит через Центр арендных споров, где стороны договариваются при поддержке специалистов, а соглашение утверждается судьёй и становится юридически обязательным. Это помогает сохранить права и ускорить разрешение конфликтов.
